title: Urban Safety Perception Through the Lens of Large Multimodal Models: A Persona-based Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the multimodal model with persona-based instructions specifying 32 different nationalities and comparing the percentage of 'Unsafe' image classifications, keyword associations, and provided reasoning across the different cultural perspectives.

Using persona-based prompts specifying 'male' or 'female' identities to classify urban street-view images and analyzing the differences in 'Unsafe' classification rates and descriptive keywords generated by the model.

Testing persona-based prompts with 'young', 'middle-aged', and 'elderly' identities to evaluate differences in urban safety perception classifications and the underlying rationales provided by the model.
